name.value: Canara HSBC Life Insurance Accidental Benefit Rider (Linked)

linked_or_non_linked.value: named "Linked" because it attaches to linked base policies; the brochure header calls it an individual non-linked non-participating pure risk rider; separate rider premium
linked_or_non_linked.quote: An Individual Non-Linked Non-Participating Pure Risk Insurance Rider

accidental_death.value: Lump sum on accidental death, up to 3 times the base sum assured. Return of premium available as a maturity benefit.

other.value: Return of premium: an amount equal to the total premiums paid on maturity.
other.quote: Return of Premium means an amount equal to the Total Premiums Paid

rider_term.value: 5 to 57 years (single or regular pay), 6 to 57 (limited pay).

premium_paying_rules.value: Single, limited (up to 56 years) or regular pay (up to 57 years). Frequency as the base policy. Can be opted at inception only. Rider premium at most 30% of the base premium.
premium_paying_rules.quote: The Rider can be opted along with base policy at incep

sum_assured_limits.value: Minimum Rs 50,000. No maximum, subject to board-approved underwriting and regulations; up to 3 times the base sum assured for accidental death.

premium_deduction.note: Not stated in the brochure text read. Needs a second read.
